title: FBD Drawer
summary: Draw scaled free body diagrams in which loads are data, not pictures. Beams, rods, lines and plates share joints; point forces, moments, uniform to triangular distributed loads, self-weight and reactions attach to them, with pin, roller and fixed supports. Everything is stored in mm, N and N·mm, entered or shown in SI or imperial, by polar or directional input against one rotatable axes triad with engineering and aircraft presets. Works by touch; exports SVG, PNG, JSON and Markdown, and a narrated Markdown deck to open in beamdswitch for slides and a video. No solver.
